result.summary: The page renders largely as expected, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains a duplicated restaurant entry, and the favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards, hurting visibility on the second card.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant twice: two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same 15–25 min ETA, same €0.90 delivery fee and identical thumbnail image sit side by side.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list by unique ID before rendering the carousel, or verify the data source isn't returning repeated entries.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) uses a dark, semi-transparent circle with a dark outlined heart, which blends into the dark image background and is barely visible. The first card uses a white circle with a dark heart.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent favorite-button style (e.g., white/light circular background with a dark heart icon plus a subtle shadow) across all restaurant cards to guarantee contrast over any image.

issues.description: Only the placeholder illustration is shown for the poké and burger cards in the 'Fastest near you' row, while the 'Popular right now' cards use full-bleed imagery, creating an inconsistent visual treatment with large empty grey areas.
issues.suggestion: Use real restaurant photography or a full-bleed branded fallback image sized to fill the card so the carousel matches the larger cards below.
